scope: Actual unchanged SDK event/list/flag/atomic writers and memory; entire 124-byte registry plus write order, stale-record purge, CONNECTED role/range error policy, DISCONNECTED, security-level/auth flags, ordered sequences, lists and deterministic exclusive retry/interference
limitations: Only the returning R1 error logger is intercepted in event execution. Event structures are fixtures; BLE observer routing and live stack delivery remain unproven.
Store-exclusive failures are deterministic instruction-hook injections, not hardware concurrency proof.
Unused/uninitialized list tail bytes are excluded; only length and initialized handles are compared.
Invalid/partial event pointers and accesses beyond the tested mapped ranges are outside this contract; original compiler output and whole-image/hardware proof remain open.
